006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.net.URI;
009import java.time.Instant;
010import java.util.ArrayDeque;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.Deque;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
015
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
019
020/**
021 * A {@link ValidationEventListener} implementation that collects timing
022 * measurements for all validation events.
023 * <p>
024 * Timing data is organized hierarchically:
025 * <ul>
026 * <li>Overall validation timing</li>
027 * <li>Per-phase timing (keyed by {@link ValidationPhase})</li>
028 * <li>Per-constraint timing (keyed by
029 * {@link IConstraint#getInternalIdentifier()})</li>
030 * <li>Per-let-statement timing (keyed by
031 * {@link ILet#getInternalIdentifier()})</li>
032 * </ul>
033 * <p>
034 * This class is thread-safe. Each thread maintains its own stack of start times
035 * to handle nested events correctly (e.g., a constraint evaluation that
036 * triggers let-statement evaluations).
037 *
038 * @see TimingRecord
039 * @see ValidationEventListener
040 */
041public class TimingCollector implements ValidationEventListener {
042  @NonNull
043  private final ConcurrentHashMap<ValidationPhase, TimingRecord> phaseTimings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
044  @NonNull
045  private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, TimingRecord> constraintTimings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
046  @NonNull
047  private final ConcurrentHashMap<ILet, TimingRecord> letTimings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
048  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidUsingVolatile") // Required for thread-safe publication
049  @Nullable
050  private volatile TimingRecord validationTiming;
051
052  /**
053   * Thread-local stacks of nano-time start values, used to support nested
054   * before/after event pairs.
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  private final ThreadLocal<Deque<Long>> startTimeStack = ThreadLocal.withInitial(ArrayDeque::new);
058
059  /**
060   * Construct a new, empty timing collector.
061   */
062  public TimingCollector() {
063    // nothing to initialize beyond field defaults
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Push a start time onto the current thread's stack.
068   */
069  private void pushStartTime() {
070    startTimeStack.get().push(System.nanoTime());
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Pop and return the most recent start time from the current thread's stack.
075   *
076   * @return the elapsed duration in nanoseconds since the corresponding push
077   */
078  private long popElapsedNs() {
079    Long startNs = startTimeStack.get().poll();
080    if (startNs == null) {
081      return 0L;
082    }
083    return System.nanoTime() - startNs;
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public void beforeValidation(@NonNull URI document) {
088    TimingRecord record = validationTiming;
089    if (record == null) {
090      record = new TimingRecord();
091      validationTiming = record;
092    }
093    record.recordStart(Instant.now());
094    pushStartTime();
095  }
096
097  @Override
098  public void afterValidation(@NonNull URI document) {
099    long elapsed = popElapsedNs();
100    TimingRecord record = validationTiming;
101    if (record != null) {
102      record.recordEnd(elapsed, Instant.now());
103    }
104  }
105
106  @Override
107  public void beforePhase(@NonNull ValidationPhase phase) {
108    phaseTimings.computeIfAbsent(phase, k -> new TimingRecord())
109        .recordStart(Instant.now());
110    pushStartTime();
111  }
112
113  @Override
114  public void afterPhase(@NonNull ValidationPhase phase) {
115    long elapsed = popElapsedNs();
116    TimingRecord record = phaseTimings.get(phase);
117    if (record != null) {
118      record.recordEnd(elapsed, Instant.now());
119    }
120  }
121
122  @Override
123  public void beforeConstraintEvaluation(@NonNull IConstraint constraint, @NonNull INodeItem target) {
124    String id = constraint.getInternalIdentifier();
125    constraintTimings.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> new TimingRecord())
126        .recordStart(Instant.now());
127    pushStartTime();
128  }
129
130  @Override
131  public void afterConstraintEvaluation(@NonNull IConstraint constraint, @NonNull INodeItem target) {
132    long elapsed = popElapsedNs();
133    String id = constraint.getInternalIdentifier();
134    TimingRecord record = constraintTimings.get(id);
135    if (record != null) {
136      record.recordEnd(elapsed, Instant.now());
137    }
138  }
139
140  @Override
141  public void beforeLetEvaluation(@NonNull ILet let) {
142    letTimings.computeIfAbsent(let, k -> new TimingRecord())
143        .recordStart(Instant.now());
144    pushStartTime();
145  }
146
147  @Override
148  public void afterLetEvaluation(@NonNull ILet let) {
149    long elapsed = popElapsedNs();
150    TimingRecord record = letTimings.get(let);
151    if (record != null) {
152      record.recordEnd(elapsed, Instant.now());
153    }
154  }
155
156  /**
157   * Get the timing record for a specific validation phase.
158   *
159   * @param phase
160   *          the phase to look up
161   * @return the timing record, or {@code null} if the phase was not recorded
162   */
163  @Nullable
164  public TimingRecord getPhaseTiming(@NonNull ValidationPhase phase) {
165    return phaseTimings.get(phase);
166  }
167
168  /**
169   * Get all phase timing records.
170   *
171   * @return an unmodifiable map of phase to timing record
172   */
173  @NonNull
174  public Map<ValidationPhase, TimingRecord> getPhaseTimings() {
175    return Collections.unmodifiableMap(phaseTimings);
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Get the timing record for a specific constraint by its internal identifier.
180   *
181   * @param constraintId
182   *          the constraint's internal identifier
183   * @return the timing record, or {@code null} if the constraint was not recorded
184   */
185  @Nullable
186  public TimingRecord getConstraintTiming(@NonNull String constraintId) {
187    return constraintTimings.get(constraintId);
188  }
189
190  /**
191   * Get all constraint timing records.
192   *
193   * @return an unmodifiable map of constraint identifier to timing record
194   */
195  @NonNull
196  public Map<String, TimingRecord> getConstraintTimings() {
197    return Collections.unmodifiableMap(constraintTimings);
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Get the timing record for a specific let-statement.
202   *
203   * @param let
204   *          the let-statement to look up
205   * @return the timing record, or {@code null} if the let was not recorded
206   */
207  @Nullable
208  public TimingRecord getLetTiming(@NonNull ILet let) {
209    return letTimings.get(let);
210  }
211
212  /**
213   * Get all let-statement timing records.
214   *
215   * @return an unmodifiable map of let-statement to timing record
216   */
217  @NonNull
218  public Map<ILet, TimingRecord> getLetTimings() {
219    return Collections.unmodifiableMap(letTimings);
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Get the overall validation timing record.
224   *
225   * @return the validation timing record, or {@code null} if validation was not
226   *         recorded
227   */
228  @Nullable
229  public TimingRecord getValidationTiming() {
230    return validationTiming;
231  }
232}
